items.title: Joseph Ralph Robinson Interview, 1960-10-12
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Emil Christian. Uh, made some records with them... [INTERVIEWEE] Back there, they were living back there. But the Shields did live on 3rd street.

ctx.x: Uh huh. Uh huh. It's funny when you all call. It look like time you all leave, the name's come to me. Yeah.

Yeah. I can't think of who it would be that made records that early. Mm. Yeah. Except the original Dixieland, Nicola Rocca and the Shields and Christian, Emil Christian. Uh, made some records with them and the Eddie Edwards trombone. They lived more, they didn't live back there though.
Back there, they were living back there. But the Shields did live on 3rd street. 3rd street. 3rd street is right. That's where they lived. Mm-hmm. On 3rd street.
